title: phase-verify-task return packet
description: Return packet for verify-only plan tasks (steps are exclusively tag: verify). No test_files or red_confirmed.

evidence.description: One entry per covered AC. A fail raises a gating finding and loops to phase-code.

tests.description: Test names / commands that prove (or failed) the AC.

verify_output.description: Short excerpt of verification output: failing commands and errors, at most ~200 lines. Full output goes in verify_output_file. Used only when verify_output_file is absent or unreadable (then last 64 KiB).

verify_output_file.description: Absolute path to a file holding the full combined stdout/stderr of the verification commands. The harness reads it for crash detection and the task sidecar.

ac_covered.description: AC ids exercised by the verification gate Deprecated — use evidence[].

context.description: Context for the blocking question (when status=stuck)

tried.description: Approaches tried before getting stuck (when status=stuck)
